relationship: Independent subset-sum LUT prototype inspired by T-MAC; not an integration or performance evaluation of the upstream generated runtime.
weight_format: Original GGUF Q2_K 16-value scales/mins preserved; bitplanes repacked without expanding code storage.
activation_precision: Exact16 uses existing int8 activations and exact int16 LUT entries; approximate8 additionally rounds subset sums to int8 with a separate scale per32 input values.
